Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: Two weeks before he is scheduled to depart from devastated planet Earth forever, a drone repairman rescues a woman from a downed spaceship, triggering a final battle to save mankind.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.

programme.title: The Craft
programme.desc: A new girl at an LA high school finds it difficult to make friends, and teams up with three fellow outcasts known as the Bitches of Eastwick. However, her telekinetic powers turn the supernatural games in which the three have been dabbling, into something much more sinister.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: A party of high school students settle in a woodland cabin for the weekend. When they find and read a copy of 'The Book of the Dead', a tome that raises not just demons outside the walls but within, they become demonically possessed with murderous desires.

programme.title: Escape From the 21st Century

programme.title: Constantine
programme.desc: Supernatural tale based on the cult comic book 'Hellblazer'. Chain-smoking loner Constantine tries to buy his place in heaven by banishing earth-bound demons back to hell, but his fate is tied up with Angela, a policewoman investigating the alleged suicide of her twin.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview

programme.title: Xeno

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: A new bride is left under the care of friends when her husband travels to Transylvania for a meeting with Count Orlok. Plagued by horrific visions and an increasing sense of dread, she soon encounters an evil force that's far beyond her control.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Sequel to the sci-fi comedy about a top-secret government task force set up to deal with unruly extraterrestrials.
